_comment: Reusable DISCUSSION DIMENSIONS (the spec's 'domains'). The Planner selects and adapts a subset for a given topic and may also invent new ones. Each has a name, description, importance (0-1 default weight), example questions, and recommended expert categories (matching categories in roles.json). Add a dimension by adding an object here.

dimensions.name: Scientific Validity
dimensions.description: Is the underlying claim scientifically sound?
questions: What does the best evidence show?
How strong is the causal inference?

dimensions.name: Mechanism
dimensions.description: How and why does it work?
questions: Where could the mechanism break down?

dimensions.name: Effectiveness
dimensions.description: How well does it achieve its aim?
questions: For whom does it work best?

dimensions.name: Safety & Risk
dimensions.description: What are the harms and risks?

dimensions.name: Economics
questions: What are the costs and benefits?

dimensions.name: Ethics
questions: Who benefits and who is harmed?

dimensions.name: Technology & Feasibility
dimensions.description: Can it be built and deployed?

dimensions.name: Psychology & Behavior
dimensions.description: How people actually behave and decide.

dimensions.name: Alternatives
dimensions.description: What else could be done instead?

dimensions.name: Evidence Quality
dimensions.description: How good is the evidence base?
questions: How strong and unbiased is the evidence?

dimensions.name: Uncertainty
dimensions.description: What we do not and cannot yet know.

dimensions.name: Stakeholders & Power
dimensions.description: Whose interests dominate and who is absent.
questions: Who has power here and who doesn't?

dimensions.name: Equity & Distribution
dimensions.description: How gains and losses are distributed.
questions: Does it widen or narrow gaps?

dimensions.name: Trust & Legitimacy
questions: Is the authority behind it legitimate?

dimensions.name: Implementation & Operations
questions: Who executes it and can they?

dimensions.name: Scalability
dimensions.description: Does it hold up from pilot to full scale?

dimensions.name: Political Feasibility
dimensions.description: Can it actually be adopted or passed?

dimensions.name: Measurement & Metrics
dimensions.description: How success is defined and gamed.
questions: How would the metric be gamed?

dimensions.name: Reversibility & Lock-in
dimensions.description: Can it be undone? Path dependence.

dimensions.name: Time Horizon
questions: How should we discount the future?

dimensions.name: Security & Misuse
questions: How could it be misused or attacked?

dimensions.name: Privacy & Data
questions: What data is collected and by whom?
